name: Andrea Parker
source:
"She is the niece of a fairly famous man who owns a successful security Company. She grew up with Jessie, her mother, after her father died when she was still little. Her uncle was the only father figure around for most of her life. He taught her several fighting styles, meaning Andrea is well trained. She also learned from him to love camping and being outdoors.
Andrea is very outgoing, loves a good time and, unfortunately for her, she always gets together with the bad boy type. She hasn't found real love yet. Being a nature lover, Andrea spends most of her time at her uncles' lake house from time to time. To her friends she is simply called 'Andi'. Currently, she's single."

[In-game description]
